nodes.title: [0.8] CURSOR_API_KEY in GitHub Actions
nodes.description:
## Objective
CURSOR_API_KEY in GitHub Actions (`lcp-build-plan:phase-0/0.8`).

## Build context
Team service account secret configured for agent workflows.

## Scope
- GitHub repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
- `.github/workflows/seo-weekly.yml`
- `.github/workflows/seo-weekly-dry-run.yml`

## Constraints
- PR-only publish gate; branch from `development` → `feature/<topic>`
- Do not modify `.env*`, Supabase migrations, or CMS auth without explicit approval
- Agent write scope: `src/app/**`, `src/content/`, `content-library/`, `content-registry/`, `scripts/seo-orchestrator/`, `agents/`, `.github/workflows/`

## Steps
1. Add `CURSOR_API_KEY` secret on the repo (team service account)
2. Confirm workflow files reference the secret name exactly
3. Run `seo-weekly-dry-run.yml` via workflow_dispatch to validate secret wiring (no cloud spend if dry-run)

## References
- docs/BUILD_PLAN.md
- docs/AGENT_SEO_AUTOMATION.md
- docs/TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md
- Linear marker: `lcp-build-plan:phase-0/0.8`

nodes.title: [2.3] First merged agent PR
nodes.description:
## Objective
First merged agent PR (`lcp-build-plan:sprint-2/2.3`).

## Build context
FAQ + date touch on one service page; human merge → Vercel.

## Agent
ServiceRefreshAgent | track:A

## Scope
- One national service page under `src/app/**/page.tsx`
- `agents/prompts/service-refresh.md`
- `scripts/seo-orchestrator/src/dispatch.ts`

## Constraints
- PR-only publish gate; branch from `development` → `feature/<topic>`
- Do not modify `.env*`, Supabase migrations, or CMS auth without explicit approval
- Agent write scope: `src/app/**`, `src/content/`, `content-library/`, `content-registry/`, `scripts/seo-orchestrator/`, `agents/`, `.github/workflows/`

## Steps
1. Run orchestrator dry-run to pick a service refresh task
2. Dispatch ServiceRefreshAgent (cloud) for FAQ + visible date touch on one service page
3. Open PR with `.github/pull_request_template/seo-agent.md`; human merges to trigger Vercel

## References
- docs/BUILD_PLAN.md
- docs/AGENT_SEO_AUTOMATION.md
- docs/TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md
- Linear marker: `lcp-build-plan:sprint-2/2.3`
nodes.acceptance: One agent PR merged to `development` (or `main` per workflow); page shows updated FAQ/date
